name: Sentier Adrien Ries
description_md:
Sentier Adrien Ries is a hard waymarked hiking route in LU measuring 50.1 km. It features a circular shape that starts and finishes at the same place, involving 1212 m of ascent and 1194 m of descent.

The route is signposted as SARI within a regional waymarked hiking network. Completing the journey takes about 16 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule. Along the way, the path passes Diekirch within 300 m, Berg Castle within 500 m, and Luxembourgish within 800 m.
